server_info.name: DCL Trust Oracle
server_info.description: Deterministic AI audit layer providing tamper-evident, privacy-first policy evaluation and post-action forensic decoding via x402 micropayments.

tools.name: evaluate_fast
tools.description: FAST Pre-Action Audit ($0.01). For high-volume, low-risk LLM outputs. Returns a tamper-evident tx_hash. Does NOT store raw content.

response.description: The LLM output text to be evaluated.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the AI agent making the request.

tools.name: evaluate_strict
tools.description: STRICT Pre-Action Audit ($0.05). For high-stakes outputs requiring deeper analysis and higher confidence thresholds.

response.description: The LLM output text to be evaluated.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the AI agent making the request.

tools.name: evaluate_jailbreak
tools.description: PRE-ACTION Instruction Adherence Check ($0.02). Detects prompt injection patterns, role-hijacking attempts, and structural anomalies in LLM inputs/outputs.

response.description: The LLM output text to be evaluated.

tools.name: evaluate_safety
tools.description: PRE-ACTION Baseline Safety Check ($0.01). Fast screening for known harmful text patterns and policy violations. Optimized for high throughput.

response.description: The LLM output text to be evaluated.

tools.name: evaluate_quality
tools.description: PRE-ACTION Content Quality & Drift Check ($0.03). Evaluates hallucination risk, format adherence, and contextual drift against baseline metrics.

response.description: The LLM output text to be evaluated.

tools.name: evaluate_batch
tools.description: PRE-ACTION Bulk Processing ($0.10). Evaluates up to 20 items in a single x402 transaction. Cost-effective for multi-turn dialogue history or dataset sampling.

tools.name: pipeline_start
tools.description: SESSION Management ($0.05). Initializes a long-running audit session for continuous drift tracking across multiple LLM calls. Returns a unique pipeline_id.

tools.name: audit_decode
tools.description: POST-ACTION Basic Audit ($0.10). Verify a past decision by tx_hash. Returns metadata (verdict, confidence, agent_id, reason) without exposing original raw content.

tx_hash.description: The transaction hash returned by a previous evaluate call.

tools.name: audit_decode_deep
tools.description: POST-ACTION Deep Forensic Audit ($0.50). For detailed investigations. Provides everything in basic audit PLUS extended drift context, tamper-evidence indices, and environmental metadata.

tx_hash.description: The transaction hash to investigate deeply.
